rules.name: cs-03-funnel-legacy-vs-new-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT DISTINCT trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs
SELECT DISTINCT trade_id, contract_number, counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.counterparty_parent FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a ON a.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE a.value_date = :valueDate

SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d JOIN opera.deal_active_lots_table a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = d.business_unit AND a.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND a.value_date = :valueDate

SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.counterparty_parent FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a ON a.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE a.value_date = :valueDate AND a.active_lots != 0

SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id, d.contract_number, d.counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d JOIN opera.deal_active_lots_table a ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = d.business_unit AND a.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND a.value_date = :valueDate AND a.active_lots != 0
SELECT DISTINCT trade_id, contract_number, client_code FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT DISTINCT trade_id, contract_number, client_code FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate
